name: patents_search
description: Search Lens.org patent database by free-text or Lucene query (requires Bearer token); returns up to 1000 patent records with title, applicant, filing date, and claims.

name: scholarly_search
description: Search Lens.org scholarly works (academic papers, preprints) by free-text or Lucene query (requires Bearer token); returns title, authors, journal, year, and DOI.

name: patent
description: Fetch a single Lens.org patent record by its lens_id (requires Bearer token); returns full bibliographic data including claims, inventors, and priority dates.

name: scholarly
description: Fetch a single Lens.org scholarly work by its lens_id (requires Bearer token); returns full metadata including abstract, authors, citations, and open-access links.
